CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to content organization or access was present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinates) and its origin/organization are both explicitly given for the same referent and time, and status distinctions (origin kinds) are present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition language linked to content organization/access was provided.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented items (red/blue coordinates) with named referents and attributes.

D.rationale: Origins/kind entries (estimates/history/command) are provided separately from the coordinate content, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Origin and inheritance metadata describe how content is organized/presented and whether it is current or a candidate (represented_time), i.e. presentation/access description.
